system_prompt:
You are an expert D2 diagram generator. Generate valid D2 diagram code based on the user's requirements. Your output must be ONLY valid D2 code that can be rendered directly. No explanations, no markdown, just pure D2 syntax. Follow these D2 syntax rules:

1. Objects: Define with 'object_name: "Label"'
2. Connections: Use '->' for directional, '<-' for reverse, '--' for undirected
3. Containers: Use nested syntax with braces: 'container: { nested_object: "Label" }'
4. Shapes: Use shape attribute: 'object: "Label" { shape: circle/rectangle/diamond/cylinder/cloud/etc }'
5. Styling: Use style: 'object: "Label" { style.fill: #color }'
6. Labels on connections: 'object1 -> object2: "label"'
7. Layout: Use 'direction: right/down/up/left' for orientation

Generate ONLY the D2 code, nothing else.

d2_capability_tests.name: Basic Hierarchy and Flow
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing a simple system where a User accesses a Web Server, which then connects to two separate Database clusters, 'Primary' and 'Backup'. Place the two databases inside a container labeled 'Data Tier'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Layout and Missing Connector Type
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram of a flow where 'API Gateway' forwards requests to a 'Microservice A' or 'Microservice B'. Show a relationship between Microservice B and a 'Shared Cache'. The whole flow should be displayed horizontally.

d2_capability_tests.name: Complex Attributes and Styling
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram. Define three components: 'Frontend', 'Backend', and 'Auth Service'. Make 'Auth Service' a circle shape with a blue fill. Show 'Frontend' connecting to 'Backend' and 'Backend' connecting to 'Auth Service' with a label 'Token Check'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Ambiguous Naming and External Entity
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram modeling a high-level system where 'User' interacts with the main 'App', and the 'App' needs to access a 'Storage'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Multi-Dimensional Containment and Relationship
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with two main containers, 'Development' and 'Production'. Inside 'Development', put a 'Test Server' that connects directly to a 'Database Instance' located inside the 'Production' container. Label the connection 'Deployment Pipeline'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Sequence-like Flow
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 sequence-like flow for a user logging in: User -> Browser -> API Gateway -> Authentication Service.

d2_capability_tests.name: Flowchart Decision Node
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 flowchart starting with 'Start Process'. Use a diamond shape for the decision 'Is Data Valid?'. If true, go to 'Save Data'. If false, go to 'Send Error Alert'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Inheritance/Class Structure
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram modeling a simple class structure: 'Dog' and 'Cat' inherit from 'Animal'. The 'Dog' class has a method bark(). Use the D2 class shape.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: System Context Diagram (C1)
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram (C4 Context Level) showing the 'Payment Processing System' that interacts with the 'Customer' and an external 'Bank API'. Show the 'Customer' using the system.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Container Diagram (C2) Focus
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram (C4 Container Level) showing the 'Customer Portal'. Decompose it to include a 'Web Application' (Node.js), a 'Mobile App', and a 'PostgreSQL Database'. Show relationships.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Component Diagram (C3) Focus
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram (C4 Component Level) showing the internal components of a 'Web Application'. Include 'Authentication Service', 'Payment Gateway Adapter', and 'API Controller'. Show the 'API Controller' using the other two services.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Flow and Technology (C2)
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing a C4 container architecture with technology stack. Include 'User Interface' (React), 'API Server' (Python), 'Database' (PostgreSQL), and 'Cache' (Redis). Show all connections and technologies used.

d2_capability_tests.name: Testing Edge Labels and Protocols
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing components communicating via different protocols. Include 'Web Client' (HTTP), 'API Server' (REST), 'Message Queue' (AMQP), and 'Database' (TCP).

d2_capability_tests.name: Object Styling (Background Color)
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with styled objects. Create nodes for 'Success Node' (green background), 'Error Node' (red background), and 'Pending Node' (yellow background). Show flow between them.

d2_capability_tests.name: Directional Layout Change
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with a top-down layout showing: 'Client' at top, 'Load Balancer' below, 'Server 1', 'Server 2', 'Server 3' in the middle, and 'Database' at bottom.

d2_capability_tests.name: Cross-System Labeled Edge
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing an 'Internal System' and an external 'External API'. Connect them bidirectionally with labels 'Sends Requests' and 'Returns Data'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Container Labeling and Grouping
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with containers representing 'Frontend Layer', 'Application Layer', and 'Data Layer'. Group related components within each container.

d2_capability_tests.name: Shape Customization
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram using various shapes: rectangle for 'Service', cylinder for 'Database', cloud for 'Cloud Storage', and circle for 'Cache'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Sub-Object Naming (Dots)
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing nested components using dot notation: 'system.frontend.header', 'system.frontend.body', 'system.backend.api', 'system.backend.worker'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Testing Simple Naming Conventions
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with simple naming: Create nodes named user, web_server, cache, database and connect them with arrows showing data flow.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Ambiguous C4 Level
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing a C4 system with all four levels: Context (System), Container, Component, and Code levels visible in one diagram.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Container Decomposition of Frontend
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing how a 'Web Application' container decomposes into 'React App', 'API Client', 'Authentication Module', and 'State Management'.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: External System Boundary
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing your system boundary with internal components on one side and external systems (Payment Gateway, Email Service, SMS Service) on the other.

d2_capability_tests.name: C4: Component Flow with Databases
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram showing components within a container: 'REST Controller', 'Business Logic', 'Data Access Layer', connected to 'PostgreSQL' and 'Redis Cache'.

d2_capability_tests.name: Testing Complex Container Nesting
d2_capability_tests.description: Generate a D2 diagram with deeply nested containers: System > Subsystem > Module > Component, showing relationships between nested elements.
